description: This Java source file defines a MatrixStack class, which implements a mathematical matrix stack similar to OpenGL ES's internal matrix stack. It provides methods for various matrix operations such as load, multiply, orthogonal, frustum, push, pop, rotate, scale, and translate, using both float and fixed-point representations.

classes.name: MatrixStack
classes.description: A class that implements a stack of 4x4 matrices, allowing push and pop operations, with methods for common matrix transformations and loading matrices from various sources.

methods.name: glFrustumf
methods.description: Sets up a perspective projection matrix with specified frustum bounds using float parameters.

methods.name: glFrustumx
methods.description: Sets up a perspective projection matrix with specified frustum bounds using fixed-point integer parameters.

methods.name: glLoadIdentity
methods.description: Resets the current matrix to the identity matrix.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixf
methods.description: Loads a matrix from a float array starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixf
methods.description: Loads a matrix from a FloatBuffer.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixx
methods.description: Loads a matrix from an int array, converting fixed-point to float.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixx
methods.description: Loads a matrix from an IntBuffer, converting fixed-point to float.

methods.name: glMultMatrixf
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another matrix from a float array.

methods.name: glMultMatrixf
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another matrix from a FloatBuffer.

methods.name: glMultMatrixx
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another from an int array, converting fixed-point to float.

methods.name: glMultMatrixx
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another from an IntBuffer, converting fixed-point to float.

methods.name: glOrthof
methods.description: Sets up an orthogonal projection matrix with float parameters.

methods.name: glOrthox
methods.description: Sets up an orthogonal projection matrix with fixed-point integer parameters.

methods.name: glPopMatrix
methods.description: Pops the top matrix off the stack.

methods.name: glPushMatrix
methods.description: Pushes a copy of the current matrix onto the stack.

methods.name: glRotatef
methods.description: Applies a rotation transformation around an arbitrary axis.

methods.name: glRotatex
methods.description: Applies a rotation transformation with fixed-point integer parameters.

methods.name: glScalef
methods.description: Applies scaling transformation along x, y, z axes.

methods.name: glScalex
methods.description: Applies scaling with fixed-point integers.

methods.name: glTranslatef
methods.description: Applies translation transformation.

methods.name: glTranslatex
methods.description: Applies translation with fixed-point integers.

methods.name: getMatrix
methods.description: Copies the current top matrix to the provided float array starting at the specified offset.

methods.name: fixedToFloat
methods.description: Converts fixed-point integer to float.

methods.name: preflight_adjust
methods.description: Checks the stack for underflow or overflow before adjusting the stack pointer.

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the stack pointer by a specified direction.
